description: See a clip at EXACT seconds: up to 12 frames, in the order you list them, tiled into one image and shown. Use it to check what is on screen where you plan a cut, whether a motion has ended, or whether a face drifted between two moments — lab_contact_sheet spreads frames evenly and cannot answer 'what is at 3.2 s'. A second past the clip's end is rejected by name, not clamped. Works on generated clips (video_id) AND on your own uploaded footage (project_id + asset_key from lab_add_media) — look at it before you cut it. Free (no credits).

asset_key.description: Storage key of uploaded footage (from lab_add_media / lab_list_assets). Needs project_id

kachel_breite.description: Width of one frame in px (default 480)

project_id.description: Project the asset_key belongs to — required with asset_key

sekunden.description: Seconds into the clip, e.g. [0.5, 3.2, 3.24]. Order is kept: left to right, then the next row (4 per row)

video_id.description: Generated video id (from lab_animate/lab_job_status) — positive integer as string. Give this OR asset_key

name: lab_bilder
title: Frames at Seconds
